issue_context.title: Add `CreatePlacementPolicyWithInfo` to interface `ddl.DDL` to support br restore
issue_context.body: required by #32290 to help br restore placement policies

review_comments: is there any chance OnExistIgnore policy ddl reach here 🤔？

Good point, it is possible when a placement policy(say `S`) does not exist before a DDL job is submitted( https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/32986/files#diff-b7c54f7dad7257cbe4fa04b8d76c9bed694e2e2e7c5599f45eb2172d8d4ff8a7R2329) but being created when the DDL job is in the queue and executed here.

It happens when two `CREATE PLACEMENT POLICY IF NOT EXISTS ...` executed concurrently in multiple clients. However, reporting an error might be a better result for the users, although it seems weird.

> WARNING: the DDL owns the `policy` after calling this function

What does 'own' mean exactly? Is it something like the 'ownership' in Rust?

This comment is copied from `CreateTableWithInfo` .  But yes, I think it is something like 'ownership' in Rust, the policy in the argument will be referred by the job in args. I'm not sure what will happens if we use it after calling the function, but it's better not to do it.
